units.source_text: 也许苗子已经觉察到尽管是孪生姐妹，但彼此身份太悬殊了吧。

en.t: Perhaps Naeko had already realized that although they were twin sisters, the difference in their positions was far too great.

units.source_text: 千重子一想到这些，就无话可说了。

en.t: When Chieko thought of this, she had nothing more to say.

units.source_text: 然而，被遗弃的难道不就是自己吗？！

en.t: And yet, was it not she herself who had been abandoned?!
